source: Playwright Chromium with deterministic fake MediaDevices/MediaRecorder and mocked same-origin API responses
checks: unsupported codecs are rejected before microphone access
denied microphone path exposes an accessible fallback
missing microphone path exposes an accessible fallback
empty recording is rejected and microphone tracks stop
oversized recording is rejected before multipart submission
supported codec creates a preview and same-origin multipart transcript request
reset clears recording state, stops tracks and revokes its blob URL
replacement and pagehide release active tracks, recorder and object URLs
navigation during active capture stops the live microphone track
late microphone permission result is stopped after reset and cannot start stale recording
provider failure remains visible and does not report transcription success
